span.p:
SEMANTIC ROUTER — pre-dispatch
embedding-similarity intent match
against a small labeled intent set
no training (ADR-009)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
off — UC-3 finance_advisor
high stakes: always frontier tier
no probe, no added TTFB

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
call small tier
NON-streaming — fully buffered
nothing released yet

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
≥ tau_route
deliver the buffered text
through the normal sentence pipeline
cheap answer, kept

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
< tau_route
re-dispatch to frontier (streaming)
cascade_escalated = true

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SENTENCE PIPELINE
same checks either way
routing does not exempt a response

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
✗ NEVER: mid-stream re-dispatch
if the small tier streamed first, its early
sentences would already be released — and
released sentences cannot be recalled (ADR-002).
Buffering the probe is what makes the
cost mechanism compatible with the
interception guarantee.

div.style: color: rgb(75, 85, 99) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.i:
Trade-off, stated in the demo: the probe adds TTFB
(a full small-tier generation before the first byte).
Measured in bench_latency, not hand-waved.
